seat_roster.lens: coherence and contract completeness - can an implementer code every section without asking; every term defined once; every event/ref/scenario referenced exists; owner directives honored verbatim.

orchestration and throughput - reducer capacity model, pipelined publication attribution (depth 1 vs 2 at the same derived P_pub), lease/fence correctness under concurrency, recovery semantics, substrate provably not the bottleneck.
timeline realism and testability - Stage S and Phase 1 line items, manifest-derived forecasts and the critical path, every scenario has an executable pass criterion, phase gates runnable as written.

concurrency and recovery adversary - races between floors/sidecars/reducer, crash points (n-commit/n+1-build handoff, relay commit, helper-result ingress), idempotency keys that dedup a valid event or admit a stale one, index.lock and shared-worktree hazards.

autonomy and owner directives - advisory budgets (budget_mode default unrestricted, nothing stalls), latch episodes with one ROTATE_REQUEST and automatic resume, bounded WAIT-*/BLOCKED-CAPACITY dispositions, no new owner gates, Tier 0 stopping rule and rubric_id pinning.

Codex design explorer: cross-family routing under latch/rotation, deterministic attestation seat identities, reducer capacity ceiling, Phase 2 arithmetic and resumability, Tier 0 coherence with its evidence.
Codex orchestration verifier: safety gates, contract completeness, recovery semantics, quorum/attestation soundness, trust anchor and revocation, seal/immutability, no single-lane authority.

Codex implementer: can you code every section on a shared Windows git checkout without asking a question; are the registry fences, epochs, quota adapter fields, unit table, and reducer supervisor implementable; is the build stage honest.

blinding: independent seats in parallel; no score history; no other seat's output; design findings not shown; classifier sees panel blockers with seat labels stripped
composite: equal-weight mean of six dimensions per seat; panel composite = equal mean over seats
